content:
Uma: quick RFC follow-up — thinking about adding a runtime for layerwise dynamic precision (switching between FP8/INT8/4bit per layer at inference). want to capture tradeoffs and an API sketch before i turn it into a short design doc.

Samir: +1 we need this. main concerns: model quality regression surface, profiling cost, and how to express policies to users.

Jin: agree. can we lean on the existing kernel-selection hooks? runtime already chooses kernels; we could add a precision hint layer.

Rachel: question: do we do dynamic switching per-request or per-deployment? per-request would be great for cost savings but harder for caching and KV cache handling.

Uma: good point. my current thought: keep it per-deployment/route by default, but support per-request overrides via an explicit header/param that bypasses caching optimizations (opt-in).

Evan: +1 on opt-in. also need deterministic fallback path: if FP8 kernel OOMs or accuracy exceeds threshold, fall back to INT8 automatically. how do we detect "accuracy exceeds threshold" at runtime?

Samir: we shouldn't rely on online accuracy signals for automatic fallback. better to use precomputed per-layer expected error and a small canary set in prod for early detection. runtime triggers fallback if canary latency/metric degrades.

Uma: propose we store a compact "precision profile" with model metadata: a list of per-layer eligible precisions + a safe-fallback map. sample snippet:
```json
{
  "precision_profile": {
    "layers": [
      {"name_regex": "^transformer.h.\\d+\\.mlp.", "preferred": ["4bit","int8"], "fallback": "int8"},
      {"name_regex": "^lm_head", "preferred": ["fp8"], "fallback": "fp8"}
    ],
    "fallback_policy": "canary_then_rollback",
    "telemetry_keys": ["per_token_ppl","stop_token_rate"]
  }
}
```

Rachel: that looks reasonable. curious about storage size — we should compress regexes and keep the profile <1KB ideally. also ensure profiles are versioned.

Jin: runtime implications: KV cache format must be precision-agnostic or we need conversion layers. converting cached KV between precisions is expensive. so we probably restrict dynamic switching to blocks that do not touch cached KV OR require cache flush on precision change.

Uma: note added: require config flag `precision_profile.allows_cache_flush` and set default false. changing precision for layers that affect KV will either be rejected at deploy time or force a cache flush on rollout.

Evan: telemetry plan: collect offline eval metrics (ppl/rouge/embedding-drift) and lightweight in-prod canary with ~1% traffic. automated alerts if metric shift > configured delta. also collect kernel fallback counts and OOMs. ops-bot: please create a ticket to add these metrics to the model dashboard.

ops-bot: ticket created: INF-4219 — "precision-profile telemetry & canary integration".

Samir: API surface: two pieces — (1) model metadata/profile baked into model registry, (2) route-level runtime toggle: `precision_mode: "static|profile|dynamic"` and `precision_profile_id`. keep defaults conservative (static=fp16).

Rachel: rollout strategy: start with dedicated-only models, run 2 weeks of canary, compare cost/sla/quality, then open to hosted routes. also require opt-in in Console for per-request overrides.

Uma: decision checklist for the doc i'll write: 1) profile schema (regex, preferred/fallback, telemetry keys) 2) runtime behavior (cache rules, kernel selection hooks) 3) fallback & canary policy 4) deployment API + console controls 5) eval plan + gate thresholds 6) storage/versioning and size constraints.

Jin: sound good. one more: make sure quantization artifacts include calibration stats (per-channel scales) so we can re-evaluate profiles without full re-quant.

Uma: added. i'll draft the design doc this week and ping folks for quick review. thanks all :thumbsup:
